zh-CN.title: BMR 基础代谢率
zh-CN.intro: 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式，输入身高、体重、年龄与性别，估算基础代谢率 BMR，即静息状态下维持生命所需最低热量，用于营养评估与饮食计划制定。

en-US.title: Basal Metabolic Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate resting daily calorie burn with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation from height, weight, age and sex, as the baseline for any nutrition or weight plan.

zh-CN.title: 体表面积 BSA
zh-CN.intro: 体表面积（BSA）计算器。按 DuBois 公式估算体表面积，用于化疗剂量、烧伤面积与药物给药的医学计算参考。

en-US.title: Body Surface Area Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate body surface area with the DuBois equation from height and weight, used to size chemotherapy doses, burn fluid plans and paediatric drug dosing.

zh-CN.title: 纽约心功能分级
zh-CN.intro: 纽约心功能（NYHA）分级工具。按活动受限程度评估心功能分级（Ⅰ–Ⅳ），用于心衰严重程度评估与运动耐量参考。

en-US.title: NYHA Heart Function Classifier
en-US.intro: Grade cardiac function from I to IV by the degree of activity limitation and symptom pattern, following the New York Heart Association functional classification.

zh-CN.title: MAP 平均动脉压
zh-CN.intro: MAP 平均动脉压计算器。输入收缩压与舒张压，按 MAP ≈ 舒张压 + (收缩压−舒张压)/3 估算平均动脉压，反映器官灌注压力，用于循环监测参考。

en-US.title: Mean Arterial Pressure Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute mean arterial pressure as diastolic plus one third of the pulse pressure, the value used to judge organ perfusion in shock and critical care monitoring.

zh-CN.title: 心率训练区间
zh-CN.intro: 心率训练区间计算器。按最大心率法估算燃脂、有氧等训练区间，提示个体存在差异，用于运动强度分区与训练计划参考。

en-US.title: Heart Rate Training Zone Calculator
en-US.intro: Derive the five training zones from resting and maximum heart rate using the Karvonen method, and see the warm-up, aerobic, threshold and VO2 max bands.

zh-CN.title: 孕周与预产期
zh-CN.intro: 孕周与预产期计算器。按末次月经估算当前孕周与预产期（EDC），提示实际分娩可前后浮动两周，用于孕期自我管理参考。

en-US.title: Pregnancy Week and Due Date Calculator
en-US.h1: Pregnancy Week and Due Date Calculator
en-US.intro: Enter the last menstrual period or a known conception date to derive gestational age, the estimated due date and the current trimester with a week-by-week table.

zh-CN.title: 阿普加评分 Apgar
zh-CN.intro: 新生儿出生后 1 分钟和 5 分钟，从心率、呼吸、肌张力、反射与肤色五项评估 Apgar 评分，快速判断窒息程度与复苏效果，用于产房新生儿初步评估。

en-US.title: Apgar Score Calculator
en-US.intro: Score appearance, pulse, grimace, activity and respiration at one and five minutes after birth, and read the summed result with its clinical interpretation band.

zh-CN.title: Parkland 烧伤补液
zh-CN.intro: 输入烧伤面积（九分法/LBSA）与体重，按 Parkland 公式估算成人烧伤后 24 小时补液总量及前 8 小时用量，为烧伤抢救的液体复苏方案提供初步参考。

en-US.title: Parkland Burn Fluid Resuscitation Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the Parkland formula fluid volume for the first 24 hours from body weight and burn percentage, and split it into the first 8 hours and the remaining 16.

zh-CN.title: 每日蛋白质需求
zh-CN.intro: 根据体重与活动水平（久坐、运动、高强度训练），估算每日蛋白质推荐摄入量，并给出分配建议，用于健身增肌、术后恢复等场景的营养规划参考。

en-US.title: Daily Protein Requirement Calculator
en-US.intro: Derive the daily protein target in grams from body weight and activity goal, from sedentary maintenance through endurance training to resistance training and cutting.

zh-CN.title: 输液滴速计算
zh-CN.intro: 输液滴速计算器。输入医嘱总量与输注时间，按滴系数计算输液滴速与总滴数，用于临床输液调速的参考（须结合患者情况）。

en-US.title: IV Drip Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Convert a prescribed infusion volume and duration into drops per minute and millilitres per hour for a given drop factor, with a rounded practical setting suggested.

zh-CN.title: 每日饮水推荐
zh-CN.intro: 每日饮水推荐计算器。按体重与活动/气候估算每日饮水量（含食物水分、炎热运动需增加），用于日常 hydration 管理参考。

en-US.title: Daily Water Intake Recommender
en-US.intro: Estimate daily fluid needs from body weight, activity duration and climate, and break the total between plain water, beverages and the water held in food.

zh-CN.title: 理想体重 IBW
zh-CN.intro: 使用 Devine 公式，输入身高与性别，计算成人理想体重 IBW，常用于临床药物剂量调整与营养支持的参考基准，而非评判健康胖瘦的标准。

en-US.title: Ideal Body Weight Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate ideal body weight from height and sex with the Devine and Robinson formulas, and display the healthy weight range and adjusted body weight for dosing.

zh-CN.title: 理想体重 Devine
zh-CN.intro: 使用 Devine 公式估算成人理想体重，输入身高与性别即可得到参考值，主要用于临床用药剂量与营养评估，仅作参考而非健康体重的硬性标准。

en-US.title: Devine Ideal Weight Estimator
en-US.intro: Compute ideal body weight with the Devine formula plus the Hamwi, Miller and Robinson variants, and compare your current weight against each estimate.

zh-CN.title: 血液酒精浓度 BAC
zh-CN.intro: 使用 Widmark 公式，输入饮酒量、酒精度、体重与性别，估算血液酒精浓度 BAC 及代谢归零时间，提示酒驾风险，结果仅供健康与法律意识参考。

en-US.title: Blood Alcohol Content Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate blood alcohol concentration from the number of standard drinks, body weight, sex and elapsed hours, applying the Widmark factor and hourly elimination rate.

zh-CN.title: BMI 身体质量指数
zh-CN.intro: 输入身高与体重，计算 BMI 并依据中国标准（<18.5 偏瘦，18.5–24 正常，24–28 超重，≥28 肥胖）判定体重状态，用于成人超重与肥胖的初步筛查。

en-US.title: Body Mass Index Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute BMI from height and weight in metric or imperial units, then place the value in the standard adult bands with the healthy weight range shown alongside.

zh-CN.title: 低钠血症纠正速度
zh-CN.intro: 低钠血症纠正速度估算器。输入血钠与目标值，估算治疗中血钠上升速度，明确仅作教学估算、临床须个体化治疗，用于医学教学参考。

en-US.title: Hyponatraemia Correction Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Work out the safe sodium correction rate and the infusion rate needed to raise serum sodium without exceeding the daily limit that risks osmotic demyelination.

zh-CN.title: 体脂率估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入身高、体重、年龄与性别，使用 Deurenberg 公式估算体脂率，提供身体成分的大致参考，用于健身减脂过程中的体脂变化追踪（仅供粗略估算）。

en-US.title: Body Fat Percentage Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate body fat percentage from waist, neck, hip and height using the US Navy circumference method, with the sex-specific formula and fitness band shown.

zh-CN.title: GFR 肌酐清除率 Cockcroft
zh-CN.intro: 使用 Cockcroft-Gault 公式，输入年龄、体重、血肌酐与性别，估算肌酐清除率，常用于肾病患者给药剂量调整与肾功能状态的临床评估参考。

en-US.title: Cockcroft-Gault Creatinine Clearance Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate creatinine clearance with the Cockcroft-Gault equation from age, weight, sex and serum creatinine, the estimate still used for many renal drug dose adjustments.

zh-CN.title: BMI 儿童百分位估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入儿童年龄、性别、身高与体重，估算 BMI 并对照相应年龄性别的百分位曲线，给出体重状态参考（教学简化版），建议结合 CDC/WHO 生长曲线使用。

en-US.title: BMI Percentile Estimator for Children
en-US.intro: Estimate the BMI percentile for a child or adolescent from age, sex, height and weight, and map the result to the underweight, healthy, overweight or obesity band.

zh-CN.title: 呼吸频率评估
zh-CN.intro: 呼吸频率评估工具。输入静息呼吸频率，判断是否正常或异常等级，提示异常请及时就医，用于生命体征自查参考。

en-US.title: Respiratory Rate Assessor
en-US.intro: Enter an observed breathing rate with the patient's age band to judge whether it is normal, bradypnoeic or tachypnoeic, with the reference ranges shown per age.

zh-CN.title: 儿童剂量换算
zh-CN.intro: 儿童剂量换算工具。按体重由成人剂量换算儿童给药剂量，提示实际用药须遵医嘱、不可自行决定，用于儿科用药剂量参考。

en-US.title: Paediatric Dose Conversion Calculator
en-US.intro: Convert an adult dose to a child dose by weight or by body surface area, with Clark's rule, Young's rule and the BSA method compared side by side.

zh-CN.title: 减脂热量缺口
zh-CN.intro: 减脂热量缺口计算器。按目标减重与天数估算每日热量缺口（建议 500–1000 kcal/日安全区间），用于减脂计划的热量规划。

en-US.title: Fat Loss Calorie Deficit Planner
en-US.intro: Set a daily calorie deficit from your maintenance level and target weekly weight loss, then see the projected timeline and the safe lower bound for intake.

zh-CN.title: 营养风险 NRS2002
zh-CN.intro: 营养风险 NRS2002 筛查工具。输入营养受损、疾病严重程度与年龄等评分项，汇总营养风险总分，用于住院患者营养风险筛查参考（须结合临床）。

en-US.title: NRS 2002 Nutritional Risk Screening
en-US.intro: Screen nutritional risk with the NRS 2002 tool by combining the impaired nutritional status score, disease severity score and the age adjustment.

zh-CN.title: eGFR 肾小球滤过率
zh-CN.intro: 使用 CKD-EPI 简化公式，输入血肌酐、年龄与性别，估算肾小球滤过率 eGFR，评估肾功能并提示异常（如 eGFR<60 持续三月提示慢性肾病需就医）。

en-US.title: eGFR Calculator with CKD-EPI and MDRD
en-US.h1: eGFR Calculator with CKD-EPI and MDRD
en-US.intro: Compare the CKD-EPI and MDRD study estimates of glomerular filtration rate side by side from creatinine, age and sex, and read the matching kidney function stage.

zh-CN.title: QTc 校正心率
zh-CN.intro: 使用 Bazett 公式，输入实测 QT 间期与心率，计算校正后的 QTc 值，评估 QT 间期是否延长及其与心律失常风险的相关性，用于心电图结果与用药监测。

en-US.title: Corrected QT Interval Calculator
en-US.intro: Correct the QT interval for heart rate with the Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham and Hodges formulas, and flag the prolongation thresholds for each method.

zh-CN.title: 每日热量消耗 TDEE
zh-CN.intro: 由 BMR 乘以活动因子估算每日总能量消耗 TDEE，并给出减脂（低于 TDEE 约 20%）、维持或增肌的热量摄入建议，用于体重管理与营养方案制定。

en-US.title: Total Daily Energy Expenditure Calculator
en-US.intro: Multiply your basal metabolic rate by an activity factor to get total daily energy expenditure, then show the cut, maintain and bulk calorie targets derived from it.

zh-CN.title: 血压分级
zh-CN.intro: 血压分级工具。输入收缩压/舒张压，按标准（正常<120/80、1 级 140–159/90–99 等）判定血压分级与脉压，仅供自查、以医生诊断为准。

en-US.title: Blood Pressure Grade Classifier
en-US.intro: Classify a systolic and diastolic reading into the normal, elevated or hypertension grade bands, and show pulse pressure and mean arterial pressure for context.

zh-CN.title: 跌倒风险 Morse
zh-CN.intro: 依据 Morse 跌倒评估量表，输入近期跌倒史、步态、是否需要辅助等条目快速计算跌倒风险评分，用于住院患者跌倒筛查与护理干预级别的判定。

en-US.title: Morse Fall Risk Assessment
en-US.intro: Score the six Morse fall scale items including fall history, secondary diagnosis, ambulatory aid, IV therapy, gait and mental status, and read the risk level.

zh-CN.title: 按体重给药剂量
zh-CN.intro: 按体重给药剂量计算器。输入体重与 mg/kg 给药强度，计算日剂量，提示具体用药须遵医嘱、本工具仅作计算，用于剂量估算参考。

en-US.title: Weight Based Drug Dosage Calculator
en-US.intro: Convert a milligram per kilogram prescription into a total single dose and a daily total from body weight and dosing frequency, with the maximum limit checked.

zh-CN.title: eGFR 估算肾小球滤过率
zh-CN.intro: 使用完整 CKD-EPI 公式，输入血肌酐、年龄、性别与种族等，估算肾小球滤过率 eGFR 以评估肾功能分期，结果仅供参考，医学诊断需结合临床检查。
zh-CN.desc: eGFR 估算肾小球滤过率

en-US.title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate eGFR from serum creatinine, age and sex using the CKD-EPI equation, and stage the result from G1 to G5 with the chronic kidney disease category.

zh-CN.title: 儿童退热液量
zh-CN.intro: 儿童退热液量计算器。按体重换算对乙酰氨基酚混悬液体积，提示每日上限约 75 mg/kg，用于儿童发热退药的剂量参考（须遵说明书）。

en-US.title: Pediatric Antipyretic Liquid Dose Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the single antipyretic dose in millilitres from a child's weight and the suspension concentration, with minimum and maximum dosing interval warnings included.

zh-CN.title: Wells 肺栓塞评分
zh-CN.intro: Wells 肺栓塞评分工具。输入临床疑诊要素（如下肢深静脉血栓征象、心率等），汇总 Wells 评分判断肺栓塞可能性，须结合 D-二聚体或影像检查，用于急诊分诊参考。

en-US.title: Wells Pulmonary Embolism Score
en-US.intro: Total the Wells criteria items for suspected pulmonary embolism and read the two-tier or three-tier probability band together with the suggested next diagnostic step.

zh-CN.title: CHADS₂-VASc 评分
zh-CN.intro: CHADS₂-VASc 评分工具。输入房颤患者的充血性心衰、高血压、年龄等危险因素，汇总卒中风险评分，用于抗凝决策参考。

en-US.title: CHADS2-VASc Stroke Risk Score
en-US.intro: Total the congestive heart failure, hypertension, age, diabetes, stroke, vascular disease and sex items to obtain the annual stroke risk and anticoagulation hint.

en-US.title: Descriptive Statistics Report Calculator
en-US.intro: Paste a series of numbers and derive the count, sum, mean, median, minimum, maximum, range, variance and standard deviation in one report block.

en-US.title: Management System Compliance Self-Check
en-US.intro: Score eight management system check items together with the recorded temperature and humidity, then read the total out of 80 as a percentage readiness grade.
